trigger.description: Pause the workflow until a specific date and time, then continue.
trigger.name: trigger

parameters.description: The moment the workflow waits for. Pick it from the field, or reference a variable with @ to wait for a date and time an earlier step produced.
parameters.name: datetime

returns.description: No output. The workflow carries on once the chosen date and time arrives.

wait.description: Pause the workflow for a set amount of time before continuing. Useful when another app, page, or email needs time to update.
wait.name: wait

parameters.description: How long to pause before the workflow continues. Pick the unit of time on the right.
parameters.name: seconds

parameters.description: The unit of time the interval is measured in.
parameters.name: unit

returns.description: No output. The workflow carries on once the pause ends.
